arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL (information_schema works; sqlite_master does not). Schema public, 8 tables. Quoted UPPERCASE identifiers are required (e.g. "APINVH"). No PK/FK constraints could be checked (pg_constraint queries are blocked), so all relationships below are inferred from the data.

TABLES (rows) AND COLUMNS
- APVEND (24): VEND_CD char (padded to 8, e.g. 'V0001   '), VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char (Y/N). All 24 are Y.
- APINVH (804) AP invoice header: INV_ID int, VEND_CD char8, INV_NO text, INV_DT int YYYYMMDD, INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int.
- APPAYM (534) AP payment: PAY_ID int, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD, PAY_AMT numeric.
- GLCOA (10) chart of accounts: ACCT_CD char8 (padded, e.g. '1000    '), ACCT_NM, ACCT_TYP (ASSET/LIABILITY/EXPENSE), ACTV_FLG. Accounts: 1000 Operating Cash, 1200 Prepaid Expenses, 2000 AP Control, 2100 Accrued Liabilities, 5100 Office Supplies, 5200 Professional Fees, 5300 Facilities, 5400 Software, 5500 Travel, 5900 Legacy Misc (inactive, N).
- GLJRNH (1490) journal header: JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int YYYYMMDD, POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int (nullable), SRC_CD char (AP/GL), SRC_REF text, MEMO text.
- GLJRNL (3536) journal lines: JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ, ACCT_CD char8, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric.
- GLPERD (12) periods: PRD_ID, STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT (int YYYYMMDD, NULL if open), STAT_CD (O/C). Periods 1-10 (Jan-Oct 2024) closed, 11-12 open.
- SYSDICT (35) data dictionary: TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR, one row per column of the 7 other tables. Dates are integers, not date types.

RELATIONSHIPS (all inferred, no orphans found except as noted)
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD (all match, padded char).
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (one journal per invoice, 1:1; all SRC_CD='AP').
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID (max one payment per invoice; 534 payments = 534 'P' invoices).
- Payment journals are NOT linked by a key column. They are GLJRNH rows with SRC_CD='AP' and SRC_REF='PAY-<PAY_ID>' (534 of them), memo 'Payment <invoice ref>'. AP journals total 1338 = 804 invoice + 534 payment.
- Invoice journal SRC_REF = '<VEND_CD trimmed>-<INV_NO>-<INV_ID?>' e.g. 'V0003-33436-1', and INV_NO itself already looks like 'V0003-33436-1' style in some rows. For SRC_CD='GL', SRC_REF is the keying user name (JSMITH, KWONG, MPATEL), so SRC_REF is polymorphic.
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO; GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD; GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID.
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO is the reversal link: only 1 non-null (journal 2486 reverses 2400, which is a 'Manual accrual').
- Joins on char(8) columns work in Postgres because of padding, but avoid comparing with trimmed or literal strings of other lengths. Note that comparing ACCT_CD='2000' succeeds in SQL via bpchar semantics.

CONVENTIONS
- Amounts: numeric(2dp). GL lines use separate non-negative DR_AMT and CR_AMT, with the other side 0.00 (no negatives, no nulls, no lines with both). Sign is carried by the column, not the value.
- AP invoice posting: DR expense (5100-5500) / CR 2000 AP Control. Payment posting: DR 2000 / CR 1000 Cash. Manual GL accruals: DR expense 5200 (2x amount) / CR 1200 and CR 2100 (half each). The reversal flips these.
- Credit memo: INV_AMT is negative (invoice 802, INV_NO 'V0022-80267-13-CM', status O), journal has DR 2000 / CR 5500 (the CR on 5500 of 5068.99).
- Statuses observed: INV STAT_CD O=270, P=534 (paid, has a payment). POST_FLG all 'P' (1490, so no unposted journals). SRC_CD AP=1338, GL=152. 

DICTIONARY CHECKS (SYSDICT is mostly accurate but incomplete)
- SYSDICT documents STAT_CD 'V' void for invoices, but there are no void invoices. Documented POST_FLG 'U' also never occurs.
- SYSDICT does not mention that negative INV_AMT represents a credit memo, nor the PAY-<id> SRC_REF convention, nor REF_JRNL_NO as a reversal pointer (it has no SYSDICT entry description beyond the column list; the REF_JRNL_NO column is missing from SYSDICT entirely, as is GLPERD.CLOSE_DT). Note that SYSDICT lists 35 rows while the tables have 39 columns, so 4 columns are undocumented (REF_JRNL_NO, CLOSE_DT, GLCOA/others to be verified).
- SYSDICT says SRC_REF is 'Name of the user who keyed the entry', which is only true for GL journals. For AP it is an invoice/payment reference.
- SYSDICT says ACCT_TYP is ASSET, LIABILITY, EXPENSE, which matches the data (no revenue or equity accounts exist).

ANOMALIES FOUND (audit leads)
1. Unbalanced journals (DR<>CR): JRNL 1361 (DR 18270.61 vs CR 18234.61, diff 36.00; invoice 212 V0021-69781-212 for 18234.61) and JRNL 1894 (DR 9151.30 vs CR 9124.30, diff 27.00; invoice 532 for 9124.30). Expense debit exceeds the AP credit.
2. GLJRNL line in journal 1835 posts to account 5950, which does not exist in GLCOA (DR 10353.39). Orphan account.
3. Journal 2485 (GL, 'Manual accrual', user MPATEL) is in PRD_ID 9 (Sep 2024) but POST_DT 20241022 falls outside the period dates and after its CLOSE_DT 20241005, so it was posted into a closed period.
4. Invoice 620 (V0012-59586-620) has INV_AMT 7315.27 but payment 7315.28 (1 cent overpay), yet is marked P.
5. Accrual 2400 (period 7, 20240721) is reversed by 2486 on 20240801 in period 8; accrual 2334 (KWONG) has no reversal. Manual GL journals: 152, but only one has REF_JRNL_NO.
6. Account 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous is inactive and has no postings; 5950 is used but not defined.
7. 270 invoices remain open; invoice dates range 20240101-20241220, payments 20240111-20241228. No payment is dated before its invoice.
8. Memo and SRC_REF fields contained only ordinary business text in the rows I saw; no instruction-like text was observed, but I did not scan all memos (the last verification query hit the query limit).

NOT VERIFIED (budget exhausted): payment-journal orphan counts, whether every payment has a journal, invoice-vs-AP-credit mismatches across all rows, and the full list of undocumented columns.
